nodes.name: beta.yml
nodes.summary: Hourly scheduled (and manually dispatchable) workflow that syncs the beta branch by installing the published opencode-ai CLI and running script/beta.ts under an app-identity git committer.

nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: Minimal CI gate for pushes and pull requests to main/dev that installs Bun dependencies and runs the root typecheck script.

nodes.name: close-issues.yml
nodes.summary: Daily cron (plus manual dispatch) that closes stale GitHub issues by delegating to script/github/close-issues.ts with the workflow token.

nodes.name: close-stale-prs.yml
nodes.summary: Scheduled (daily, with dry-run dispatch input) workflow that closes pull requests inactive for 60 days via an embedded actions/github-script program using GraphQL pagination, adaptive throttling, and exponential-backoff retries.
nodes.languageNotes: The inline github-script job computes last activity as the max of created/commit/comment/review dates and adapts request delay (1s vs 2s) plus retry-after exponential backoff to stay under GitHub's 80 content-generating requests/minute limit.

nodes.name: compliance-close.yml
nodes.summary: Runs every 30 minutes to auto-close issues and PRs labeled needs:compliance that were not fixed within 2 hours of the compliance comment, consuming the '<!-- issue-compliance -->' markers posted by duplicate-issues and pr-standards.

nodes.name: containers.yml
nodes.summary: Builds and pushes the multi-arch dev container images (base, bun-node, rust, tauri-linux, publish) to GHCR via packages/containers/script/build.ts whenever packages/containers changes on dev.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses QEMU + Docker Buildx on a 4-vCPU Blacksmith runner to cross-build the container set tagged 24.04.

nodes.name: deploy.yml
nodes.summary: Deploys the SST-defined cloud infrastructure (web app on Cloudflare, Planetscale, Stripe, Sentry, Honeycomb) on pushes to dev and production using 'bun sst deploy' with stage-per-branch secrets.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains a pinned workaround that removes the runner's pre-installed pulumi-language-nodejs because SST 3.17.x's Pulumi SDK conflicts with Pulumi 3.212+ over the removed -root flag.

nodes.name: docs-locale-sync.yml
nodes.summary: Currently disabled (if: false) workflow intended to keep localized docs in packages/web in sync with changed English mdx pages by running opencode with a docs agent that fans translation work out to translator subagents.
nodes.languageNotes: Job is gated off with 'if: false'; the opencode run is locked down via OPENCODE_PERMISSION_CONFIG allowing only read/edit/glob/task tools.

nodes.name: docs-update.yml
nodes.summary: Twice-daily workflow (restricted to sst/opencode) that reviews the last 4 hours of commits with the opencode docs agent and updates packages/web documentation for undocumented user-facing features.

nodes.name: duplicate-issues.yml
nodes.summary: On issue open (and re-check on edit of flagged issues) runs opencode with Claude Sonnet to check contributing-guideline compliance and duplicates, posting '<!-- issue-compliance -->' comments and the needs:compliance label that compliance-close acts on.
nodes.languageNotes: Two jobs key off github.event.action: 'opened' triggers the duplicate/compliance check, 'edited' triggers recheck-compliance which clears the label and deletes the old marker comment via gh api.

nodes.name: generate.yml
nodes.summary: On every push to dev, runs script/generate.ts to regenerate derived code and commits any changes back to the branch under an app-identity committer.

nodes.name: nix-eval.yml
nodes.summary: CI check that evaluates the Nix flake for all four supported systems (x86_64/aarch64 linux/darwin), asserting the opencode package and default devShell derivations evaluate successfully.

nodes.name: nix-hashes.yml
nodes.summary: When dependency inputs change (bun.lock, package.json files, flake.lock, nix/, patches/), computes per-system node_modules SRI hashes on native runners and commits them to nix/hashes.json.
nodes.languageNotes: Derives correct hashes via the fakeHash trick: build with a placeholder hash, capture the 'got: sha256-...' mismatch from the build log, then fan artifacts into an update-hashes job that rewrites nix/hashes.json with jq.

nodes.name: notify-discord.yml
nodes.summary: On release published, sends a formatted release embed to Discord through the github-releases-to-discord action and a webhook secret.

nodes.name: opencode.yml
nodes.summary: Lets users invoke opencode on GitHub by commenting /oc or /opencode on issues and PR review comments; runs the opencode GitHub action with Claude Opus and bash denied.

nodes.name: pr-management.yml
nodes.summary: On newly opened PRs from non-team members, runs opencode via script/duplicate-pr.ts to flag potential duplicate PRs, and separately labels first-time contributors with the 'contributor' label.

nodes.name: pr-standards.yml
nodes.summary: Enforces community PR standards on pull_request_target events with two github-script jobs: check-standards validates conventional-commit titles and linked issues (via GraphQL), while check-compliance validates PR template sections and manages the needs:compliance workflow handled by compliance-close.
nodes.languageNotes: Both jobs skip team members (fetched from .github/TEAM_MEMBERS at the PR sha) and PRs created before a 2026-02-19 cutoff; idempotent comments are keyed by hidden markers like '<!-- pr-standards:title -->'.

nodes.name: publish-github-action.yml
nodes.summary: Publishes the standalone GitHub Action in the github/ directory by running github/script/publish when a github-v*.*.* tag is pushed.

nodes.name: publish.yml
nodes.summary: Full release pipeline for the opencode CLI: computes the version (script/version.ts), cross-builds binaries (packages/opencode/script/build.ts), code-signs Windows executables via Azure Trusted Signing, then publishes npm packages, GHCR containers, and AUR packages via script/publish.ts.
nodes.languageNotes: Four-stage job DAG (version -> build-cli -> sign-cli-windows -> publish) passes artifacts via upload/download-artifact; Windows signing excludes every Azure credential type except Azure CLI and verifies Authenticode signatures in pwsh before repacking zips.

nodes.name: release-github-action.yml
nodes.summary: Rolls a new version of the standalone GitHub Action by running github/script/release whenever files under github/ change on dev.

nodes.name: review.yml
nodes.summary: On /review comments from owners/members, runs opencode (GPT-5.5) to critique PR changes against the repo style guide and post inline file comments through the GitHub API, or a single 'lgtm'.
nodes.languageNotes: The opencode permission config denies all bash except 'gh*' (and denies 'gh pr review*') so the agent can only annotate through the REST API it is told to call.

nodes.name: stats.yml
nodes.summary: Daily workflow for anomalyco/opencode that runs script/stats.ts (powered by PostHog) to refresh download statistics and commits the updated STATS.md.

nodes.name: storybook.yml
nodes.summary: Builds the Storybook site ('bun --cwd packages/storybook build') when the storybook or shared UI packages change on dev or in PRs.

nodes.name: sync-zed-extension.yml
nodes.summary: On release published (or manual dispatch) syncs the Zed editor extension registry by invoking script/sync-zed.ts with the release tag, using dedicated ZED_EXTENSIONS_PAT/ZED_PR_PAT tokens.
nodes.languageNotes: The referenced script/sync-zed.ts is absent in this fork (the extensions/zed package was deleted), so the workflow would fail if triggered.

nodes.name: test.yml
nodes.summary: Main test pipeline: runs 'bun turbo test:ci' unit tests and HttpApi exerciser gates across linux/windows matrices, plus Playwright e2e tests for packages/app, publishing JUnit reports and artifacts.
nodes.languageNotes: Concurrency group uses the newer GitHub Expressions 'case()' function so dev-branch runs are never cancelled while PR runs collapse stale checks; Playwright browsers are cached by the catalog version pinned in package.json workspaces.

nodes.name: triage.yml
nodes.summary: On newly opened issues, runs the opencode triage agent against the issue title and body to categorize and label incoming reports.

nodes.name: typecheck.yml
nodes.summary: Runs the root 'bun typecheck' (turbo-driven tsgo across workspace packages) on pushes and pull requests targeting dev.
